Surat's diamond belt: Bhavnagar's Nirmalnagar hub has lost an estimated 700-800 of its 1,500 diamond offices, the trade association says, as a war-driven rough shortage drags on.

President Gorsiya blames Russian rough, once 35-40% of world supply; a researcher's survey estimates one lakh of them idle. Source: VTV Gujarati, Divya Bhaskar, Mumbai Samachar, 29-30 Oct 2026.

ભાવનગરના હીરા ઉદ્યોગ પર મંદીનું ગ્રહણ: અંદાજે ૭૦૦-૮૦૦ ઓફિસો બંધ, એક લાખ કારીગરો બેરોજગાર હોવાનો અંદાજ.

Gold in Surat today: 24K Rs12,213/g, 22K Rs11,196/g; silver Rs1,55,225/kg -- 30 Oct tape (intraday reading), USD/INR 95.07.
